notes:
Tasks: a new "More Time Asked" figure lists every task somebody asked more time on, and each task card now shows whether that request is Pending, Approved or Declined. "Completed" is a button beside Filter, and the list shows every due date unless you pick one under Filter.

Assigning a task: "Assign to" comes first and "On behalf of" under it, and there is no Category any more. If you set reminders, a reminder is now simply an app notification every few hours between 9 AM and 9 PM (you can change both) until the task is done.

Cashbook: the book screen is simpler — the search box, and what the book has cost beside PDF at the top. Recording an expense asks for the book, amount, date, what you bought, the category and the bills — no payment mode or reference number. Your most used categories come first, and "Other" lets you type your own. You can now delete an expense until the company confirms it.

PDF reports: All entries, or Day-wise with category summary — each part on its own page, with each bill's picture beside its entry (tap it to open the full-size bill) and every bill attached at the end.

Language: pick it from a dropdown in Settings. Task titles, remarks, names and notifications can now appear in your language too, when the company has it switched on.

Also: messages at the bottom of the screen are smaller and go away quicker, and the in-app Help guide is updated.
